source.job: Amu selfhost and Kotoba CLI requests
source.gate: Kotoba SQLite image publication, readback and sidecar refusals (native ARM64)
source.runtime: Amu selfhost F2; native aarch64-linux static Kotoba; PATH=/nonexistent

nativeResult.behavior: On the exact two-leaf table/index roots, Kotoba deleted one key and verified the remaining row in memory; it then deleted one job, collapsed the remaining single-row tree to leaf roots, published and reopened through FS2, and read back the preserved other job through Kotoba.

scope: This qualifies only the exact two-leaf fixture and its one-row root-collapse deletion path on Linux ARM64. It does not qualify multi-row rebuilds after deletion, deeper roots, arbitrary SQLite layouts, WAL/recovery, standard SQLite locking, crash consistency, Linux x86_64, or Itonami integration.
